notes.title: Update fix for Grim Tales: The Bride
notes.notes:
We've received reports about the missing bear in the Hidden Object Scene, and have uploaded the fix for this issue. This should automatically update when you restart Steam. If you still have any trouble, please try starting a new profile or reinstall the game. 

Thank you everyone for your feedback!
